description: This script generates emulated GLSL builtin functions for HLSL shader code, based on JSON data, and outputs a C++ source file with the generated code.

classes.name: FunctionPair
classes.description: A structure representing a pair of a function's unique ID and its body code.

methods.name: reject_duplicate_keys
methods.description: Ensures no duplicate keys in JSON object pairs.

methods.name: load_json
methods.description: Loads and parses JSON data from a file, rejecting duplicate keys.

methods.name: enum_type
methods.description: Converts argument type strings into standardized enum type strings.

methods.name: gen_emulated_function
methods.description: Generates C++ code for an emulated function based on input data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main script logic for generating the HLSL emulated functions C++ source file.
